note: Service: none, from the US Department of Labor's Findings on the Worst Forms of Child Labor for Fiji (2024), which marks the prohibition of compulsory recruitment of children 'N/A' because the country has no conscription, citing art. 7 of the Royal Fiji Military Forces Act (voluntary recruitment from 16): a secondary source quoting the law, which wasn't read itself. Work: null. The same report gives 15 as the minimum age for work (art. 92 of the Employment Relations Promulgation 2007) and 13 to 15 for light work, but the law wasn't read, so what it says of young performers is unknown: the government's laws site (laws.gov.fj) is a script application whose deep links answer 404 to this client, PacLII (paclii.org) answers 403 behind Cloudflare, its AustLII mirror didn't connect, an archive.org snapshot of PacLII's text (2025-01-30) couldn't be fetched (connections reset), and the Ministry of Employment's site didn't connect (2026-10-31). Majority: null, the Age of Majority Act wasn't reached for the same reasons.
